name: AI-Powered Notes with RAG
summary: Note AI is an intelligent note-taking application powered by AI, with real-time sync backed by Convex.
It lets users create and manage notes, then ask questions about them using retrieval-augmented generation with OpenAI.

name: Book Review Platform
summary: A full-stack book review platform where reviews save instantly while AI enrichment happens asynchronously, so the user never waits on a model call.

Reviews are queued through BullMQ on Redis and picked up by a separate worker process that generates a concise summary, sentiment, and relevant tags with Mastra AI. Cover images are stored on S3, and the whole stack runs containerized behind Nginx.

name: bunship
summary: A CLI that scaffolds production-ready Bun monorepos by orchestrating each framework's official scaffolder non-interactively, so generated code always matches upstream instead of drifting from a hand-maintained template.

On top of that it layers an opinionated root toolchain: Bun workspaces, oxlint and oxfmt, knip for dead-code detection, husky pre-commit hooks, and optional Docker plus GitHub Actions VPS deployment. Published to npm as create-bunship.

name: appctl
summary: A port assigner and nginx server-block generator for a host-installed nginx fronting Docker apps, making the 101st deployment the same single command as the first.

It allocates a free host port from named tiers, writes and validates the nginx config, obtains a Let's Encrypt certificate, and reloads — rolling back cleanly if nginx -t ever fails. Containers publish on loopback only, so the internet cannot bypass nginx even though Docker's iptables rules sidestep the firewall.

name: Ticketing App
summary: An event ticketing platform built as microservices, with a NATS Streaming event bus connecting independently deployable services.
It demonstrates event-driven architecture, asynchronous communication, and service isolation, with common types and middleware factored into a shared library published to npm.

name: DevOps Capstone (AWS)
summary: A capstone project provisioning an AWS VPC with public and private subnets end to end: Terraform for the infrastructure, Ansible for configuration, Docker for the workload.

Prometheus and Grafana handle monitoring, a Cloudflare Tunnel provides secure access without exposing public ingress, and GitHub Actions publishes the documentation site. The AWS resources have since been torn down.
